overview_description.description: AutoStore is a unique world-wide patented warehouse system proven to be the ideal small-goods handler for any warehouse, old or new. With standardized boxes stacked in a cube, it is easily the most space-efficient goods-to-man system on the market and can double storing capacity without increasing footprint. AutoStore is sold via a global multi-distribution network.

about_short_description.short_description: AutoStore is a automated storage and retrieval system.

product.name: AutoStore System
product.description: A modular goods-to-person automated storage and retrieval system (AS/RS) using robots, bins, a grid, workstations, and a controller to store and retrieve inventory.

product.name: CubeVerse™
product.description: A software platform that connects AutoStore system design, simulation, operations, analytics, and predictive diagnosis in a unified environment.

product.name: AutoStore Intelligence™
product.description: An AI-driven optimization layer that analyzes operational and simulation data to improve AutoStore throughput, identify constraints, and anticipate potential disruptions.

product.name: Pio
product.description: A compact AutoStore-based warehouse automation solution for small and medium-sized businesses, available through a robots-as-a-service model.

product.name: Qubit™ Fulfillment Platform
product.description: A fulfillment software platform listed in AutoStore’s system portfolio for coordinating warehouse fulfillment processes and automation operations.

identifier.value: AutoStore System Design and Simulation Services

product.name: AutoStore System Design and Simulation Services
product.description: Consulting and engineering services that configure and simulate AutoStore systems to match a facility’s space, inventory, throughput, and operational requirements before deployment.
